Final Fridays (Critical Mass)

Manhattan, KS · Social

Final Fridays (Critical Mass) is a social group ride in Manhattan, KS. It rolls last Friday of the month at 7:00 pm from Riley County Courthouse. About 2.5 miles, slow-paced. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow-paced. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Final Fridays (Critical Mass) group ride

A slow 2.5-mile group ride through downtown Manhattan and Aggieville on the last Friday of each month. It starts at the courthouse on Poyntz. Front and rear lights and a helmet are required. People usually get pizza and drinks after.
